rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something related to weather or meteorology.

example.traditional: 呢份係天氣方面嘅專業報告。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 hai6 tin1 hei3 fong1 min6 ge3 zyun1 jip6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this especially in technical or institutional contexts and in compounds such as 氣象預報.

example.english: The meteorological forecast says it will rain heavily tomorrow.
example.traditional: 氣象預報話聽日會落大雨。
example.jyutping: hei3 zoeng6 jyu6 bou3 waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 daai6 jyu5
